resources.string: Review changes before applying. Applying preserves existing data and does not start services.
Stop every group service and finish data operations before applying changes.
Group definition updated. Start services when you are ready.
The private draft will be replaced. Existing services and data will not be changed.
The engine connection is unavailable. Reconnect, then reload the definition.
The group, a service or a package changed. Reload and review again.
Stop group services and finish active operations, then review again.
This definition contains an unsupported setting. Review the document.
The definition or a required package is unavailable. Check the document and listed packages, then review again.
The operation failed. Existing data is preserved. Reload the current definition before retrying.
Download public packages or import the exact local packages, then review the definition again. Downloading does not create or start services.
Import this exact local package from Store before reviewing again.
